demos.name: AI Demo Standalone
demos.description: Generalist hands off to a specialist: two RFC 8693 exchanges build the nested act chain, scope narrowed per hop. Only a REGISTERED specialist is routed (UC2.6); the Agent Card is served and no bearer is a real 401 (UC2.7). Mock of UC2/2.5/2.6/2.7.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7710). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7710 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). The decision contract mirrors the AI-DEMO2 a2aDelegationService chained RFC 8693 exchange (scope narrowed per hop) + GatewayTokenPolicy nested-act exemption + the Agent Card registry (UC2.6 WHO-is-acting), enforced live 2026-11-06. Repo: curtismu7/ai-demo-standalone-LAB. Catalog id D122 (assigned 2026-11-07).
